title: Fig: Automated Multiagent Behavior Elicitor
abstract: arXiv:2610.28891v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Many social evaluations for multiagent systems study behaviors as they emerge from environments instead of systematically intervening in the environment to elicit such behaviors. We introduce Fig (Finding Interactions in Games), an agentic system that performs targeted elicitation interventions on game environments. It takes a natural language behavior description, decomposes it into sub-behaviors, generates new social games or selects existing ones, and executes single or combined interventions to the games' engine, opponents, instructions, and context. To evaluate model behavior, it combines built-in mechanical checks and synthetic rubric judgments. We validate the interventions, generated games, and evaluation mechanisms via human review. Models attempt the target behavior in 45.2% of episodes on average for valid scenarios generated by Fig for six test behaviors -- cooperation, exploitation, deception, covert coordination, betrayal,

translated_title: Fig：自动化多智能体行为诱发器
translated_abstract: 许多针对多智能体系统的社会评估只研究行为在环境中自然涌现的表现，而非通过系统性地干预环境来主动诱发这些行为。我们提出了Fig（Finding Interactions in Games，在游戏中发现交互），这是一个能够对游戏环境执行针对性诱发干预的智能体系统。它接受自然语言的行为描述，将其分解为子行为，生成新的社交游戏或选择现有游戏，并对游戏的引擎、对手、指令和上下文执行单一或组合式干预。为了评估模型行为，它结合了内置的机械性检查和合成的评分标准判断。我们通过人工审查验证了干预措施、生成的游戏以及评估机制。在Fig为六种测试行为——合作、剥削、欺骗、隐蔽协调、背叛等——所生成的有效场景中，模型平均在45.2%的回合中尝试目标行为。
tldr: 该论文提出了Fig系统，能够根据自然语言行为描述自动生成或选择游戏环境并进行针对性干预，从而系统性地诱发和评估多智能体模型的特定社会行为（如合作、欺骗、背叛等）。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Fig, an agentic system that automatically generates or selects game environments and applies targeted interventions to systematically elicit and evaluate specific social behaviors (e.g., cooperation, deception, betrayal) in multiagent models based on natural language behavior descriptions.
